## Speed
How fast each measured model runs, against the previous release, is in the table on the [release page](https://github.com/aosama/astronomical/releases/tag/v0.2.138).
## What's new
- **Faster prompt reading for models with experts held in memory.** - Saved prompt blocks are written in the background, so the first token no longer waits for the SSD. - On M5 and newer Macs, the routed experts of 4-bit and 6-bit models run through new kernels with the same results as before, read more of a prompt at a time, and skip a copy of every token row. - Prompt blocks line up with prompt chunks, and a fused kernel prepares whole prompt spans. - **Automatic prompt chunk.** The prompt chunk size is Automatic by default: 4,096 tokens for models with experts on an M5 or newer, 2,048 elsewhere. Observatory shows the size in use and why, and status reports it as `prompt_processing_chunk`. - **Kev** installs from the download catalog as its published MLX build. - **Status:** the custom kernel probe results and the kernels in use appear in status. Session speed averages include the running request and stay live while a prompt is read layer by layer.
## Compatibility
- The prompt chunk setting moves to `chunking.prompt_processing_chunk_size_tokens` the first time this version loads your settings. A 2,048 or 4,096 that an earlier version wrote there by default becomes Automatic. A size you chose yourself, and every per-model size, is kept. - Conversations, models and other settings are kept. - macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon.
## Distribution
The app is signed with a Developer ID certificate and Hardened Runtime, notarized by Apple and stapled. The Sparkle update feed is signed.
